question:

solution:
The given dice:

Logic: If two dice have the same two face values in the given image then the third number is opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a04170d109acd30622e1897e130764cf705010dc1898dfecf095e506313d3610.png] 

As 8 and 9 are common in both dice, then 7 and 9 are opposite to each other.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
